candidate: Application/runtime unchanged from deployed HEAD; new test and evidence are local and uncommitted.
scope: Actual GA4 Overview Revenue/Pipeline Proxy cards and source dialogs with synthetic HTTP data; adjacent consumer and page regression checks.
provenLocally: Confirmed GA4 + HubSpot + Salesforce + Shopify figures render from their mocked published responses; revenue source itemization matches those responses.
Positive HubSpot/Salesforce proxy responses render their combined amount and current modal details separately from confirmed Revenue; stale mapping amounts are ignored.
Explicit complete zero renders as zero.
Failed provider response, wrong source ID, wrong currency, missing timestamp and unreconciled item totals withhold combined proxy instead of displaying partial or stale amounts.
Failed refetch hides previously cached proxy, successful retry restores it, and confirmed Revenue stays stable.
Shopify-only configuration does not request CRM proxy APIs; removing CRM source configuration from mocked inventory removes its displayed proxy despite cached responses.
Existing GA4 publication/freshness browser, standalone Sheets proxy browser and 45 consumer calculation cases pass.

isolation.browserNetwork: All requests intercepted. Other hosts and non-GET methods abort and fail the test; unknown APIs fail the test.
isolation.nodeNetwork: Existing credential-stripped runner; DATABASE_URL empty; local-network-only preload.
isolation.cleanup: Each fixture closes its browser context in finally; suite closes Chromium. No server/database was started.

unproven: Actual provider permissions, credentials, returned data and pagination/quotas
Authenticated deployed UI and tenant isolation
OAuth/create/edit/reconnect/cancel/delete writes and real source cleanup
Natural scheduled provider refresh and missing-currency Salesforce recovery
Full Custom page rendering, CSS/visual layout and setup wizard behavior

failureClassification.detail: Normal GA4 page also reads industry benchmarks, diagnostics and geography. Diagnostic run exposed these missing mocked endpoints; fixture now supplies explicit empty responses. Diagnostic nine skips are the deliberate single-test filter.
Fixture supplied lower-case custom display names while assertion expected branded labels. Fixture now supplies HubSpot/Salesforce/Shopify labels. Nine skips are the deliberate single-test filter.
